# Prometheus exposition-format sample — "healthy" shape.
#
# Hand-synthesised to mirror what a production core Fly machine would emit
# at /internal/metrics after ~10 min of modest traffic. Metric names match
# apps/core/lib/core_web/telemetry.ex series names (translated into
# Prometheus naming by prom_ex).
#
# Key invariants this fixture encodes:
#   - all route groups report p95 well under their thresholds
#   - upload terminal counter: 95 resolved, 3 rejected, 2 timeout → 95% success
#   - no fuse open (state=1 for every fuse = healthy)
#   - Oban failure rate per queue: <=5%
#   - Ecto queue_time p95 <= 50ms
#   - BEAM memory ~120MB (well under 400MB)
